newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIAN EKRANAS POSTS 8.58 MLN LITAS H1 97 NET PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIAN EKRANAS POSTS 8.58 MLN LITAS H1 97 NET PROFIT.

text.p: Lithuania's TV screen producer Ekranas said on Tuesday that its net profit for the first half of 1997 was 8.58 million litas compared to a net profit of 59 million litas in the same period in 1996.

"Our high net profit in the first half of 1996 stemmed from the government's decision last June to write off 54 million litas debt in overdue and social insurance payments," the company's chief accountant, Rimas Skaburskis, told Reuters.
"The profit from actual TV screens production was 4.5 million litas in the first six months of 1996," he added.
Skaburskis also said that the company managed to reduce its production expenses to 25.9 million litas in the first half of the year from 29 million litas in the same period in 1996.
He also said that sales in the first half of the year fell to 137 million litas from 159 million litas.
"The unfavourably low German mark exchange rate increased the prices of our TV screens to similar products of other companies and because of tougher competition our sales went down," Skaburskis said.

The company said earlier that it had to reduce its production capacity by around 20 percent in May while waiting for a more favourable exchange rate since contracts with major clients were signed in German marks.
Ekranas is an A group company on the Vilnius bourse and was traded at 4.9 litas per share on Tuesday.
